    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """U7 transition driver — the ONLY path the scoped test transition runs.
    
    Modes:
      plan     read-only + private files: capture actual specs, generate the
               restore compose file + digest manifest, render both overlay
               configs, verify the render, seed the on-disk test marker and
               git sandbox. Touches NO container/service/key.
      apply    preflight -> build acp-ui-u7 image -> stop cron -> recreate the
               scoped services on fixed ports (OFF) -> verify isolation. Any
               failure or SIGINT/SIGTERM runs restore() first, then exits.
               Requires --self-run-id.
      on       stack compose.u7-on.yaml; recreate state+runner with the managed
               feature ON.
      off      recreate state+runner back to the OFF overlay.
      seed     HTTP-seed test fixtures (projects.json + a test board card) —
               only after marker-verified isolation; refuses otherwise.
      restore  Compose-driven return to the captured actual spec (+ cron start).
      verify   compare live inspect facts to the manifest (digests, no secrets).
    
    Guards (AGENTS.md): single acp-ui project, fixed ports, --no-deps only, no
    --remove-orphans, no `down`, no bare node/python servers, no second stack.
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import json
    import os
    import secrets
    import signal
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import time
    import urllib.request
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
    import _e2e_compose_harness as H  # noqa: E402
    import u7_restore_override as restore_gen  # noqa: E402
    
    PRIV = Path(os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/acp-u7-devin"))
    PROJECT = "acp-ui"
    SCOPED = ["state", "runner", "web", "bridge-hermes"]
    CRON = "cron"
    TEST_STATE_DIR = Path("/home/hermes/.hermes/acp-ui-state-u7")
    TEST_EXEC_DIR = TEST_STATE_DIR / "execution"
    TEST_WS_DIR = Path("/home/hermes/projects/.acp-workspaces-u7")
    TEST_OPS_DIR = Path("/home/hermes/.acp-ops-u7")
    SANDBOX = Path("/home/hermes/projects/acp-u7-sandbox")
    LIVE_STATE_DIR = "/home/hermes/.hermes/acp-ui-state"
    PORCH = os.path.expanduser(
        "~/.pi/agent/skills/pragmatic-orchestration/scripts/porch")
    
    FILES_OFF = [ROOT / "compose.yaml", ROOT / "compose.u7.yaml"]
    FILES_ON = FILES_OFF + [ROOT / "compose.u7-on.yaml"]
    
    _transition_began = False
    
    
    class StepError(RuntimeError):
        pass
    
    
    def run(cmd: list[str], timeout=120.0, ok_codes=(0,), **kw) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
        res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, **kw)
        if res.returncode not in ok_codes:
            raise StepError(
                f"{' '.join(map(str, cmd))} -> exit {res.returncode}\n"
                f"{res.stdout[-2000:]}\n{res.stderr[-2000:]}")
        return res
    
    
    def compose(files, *args, timeout=120.0):
        cmd = ["docker", "compose", "-p", PROJECT]
        for f in files:
            cmd += ["-f", str(f)]
        return run(cmd + list(args), timeout=timeout)
    
    
    def compose_json(files, *args, timeout=120.0):
        return json.loads(compose(files, *args, timeout=timeout).stdout)
    
    
    def write_private(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
        PRIV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        os.chmod(PRIV, 0o700)
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
            f.write(text)
    
    
    def capture(service: str) -> dict:
        res = run(["docker", "inspect", f"{PROJECT}-{service}-1"])
        d = json.loads(res.stdout)[0]
        write_private(PRIV / f"inspect-{service}.json", res.stdout)
        return d
    
    
    def capture_all() -> dict:
        """Actual spec of scoped services + cron status, saved privately."""
        got = {}
        for svc in SCOPED:
            got[svc] = capture(svc)
        got[CRON] = capture(CRON)
        return got
    
    
    def seed_marker() -> str:
        """Write the marker doc ON DISK into the test STATE_DIR (never HTTP)."""
        TEST_STATE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        f = TEST_STATE_DIR / f"{H.MARKER_DOC}.json"
        if f.exists():
            try:
                return json.loads(f.read_text())["data"]["nonce"]
            except Exception:
                pass
        nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)
        doc = {
            "name": H.MARKER_DOC,
            "rev": 1,
            "updatedAt": int(time.time() * 1000),
            "data": {"stateDir": "acp-ui-state-u7", "nonce": nonce,
                     "purpose": "u7 isolation marker — seeded on disk pre-transition"},
        }
        fd = os.open(f, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o644)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps(doc))
        print(f"marker seeded on disk: {f} nonce={nonce[:8]}…")
        return nonce
    
    
    def seed_sandbox() -> None:
        """Isolated git projects for workspace/role tests — host FS only."""
        for name in ("proj-a", "proj-b"):
            d = SANDBOX / name
            if (d / ".git").exists():
                continue
            d.mkdir(parents=True)
            run(["git", "-C", str(d), "init", "-q"])
            (d / "README.md").write_text(f"# u7 sandbox {name}\n")
            (d / "main.py").write_text("VALUE = 1\n")
            run(["git", "-C", str(d), "add", "-A"])
            run(["git", "-C", str(d), "-c", "user.email=u7@test.invalid",
                 "-c", "user.name=u7", "commit", "-qm", "init"])
        print(f"sandbox repos ready under {SANDBOX}")
    
    
    def render_check() -> list[str]:
        """`docker compose config` renders + asserts; returns findings list."""
        notes = []
        off = compose_json(FILES_OFF, "config", "--format", "json")
        on = compose_json(FILES_ON, "config", "--format", "json")
        write_private(PRIV / "render-off.json", json.dumps(off, indent=2))
        write_private(PRIV / "render-on.json", json.dumps(on, indent=2))
    
        def svc(cfg, name):
            return cfg["services"][name]
    
        st, rn, web, bh = (svc(off, s) for s in SCOPED)
        # 1. ops mount: exactly one /run/acp-ops target, source .acp-ops-u7
        ops = [v for v in st.get("volumes", []) if v.get("target") == "/run/acp-ops"]
        assert len(ops) == 1 and ops[0]["source"] == str(TEST_OPS_DIR), \
            f"state /run/acp-ops resolves {ops!r} — must be solely {TEST_OPS_DIR}"
        assert not any(v.get("target") == "/run/acp-ops"
                       for v in rn.get("volumes", [])), \
            "runner must NOT see the ops dir"
        assert not any(v.get("target") == "/run/acp-ops"
                       for v in bh.get("volumes", [])), \
            "bridge-hermes must NOT see the ops dir"
        notes.append("ops mount: state-only ro, source .acp-ops-u7, runner/bridge absent")
        # 2. isolated paths
        env_st = st.get("environment", {})
        env_rn = rn.get("environment", {})
        assert env_st.get("STATE_DIR") == str(TEST_STATE_DIR), env_st.get("STATE_DIR")
        assert env_st.get("ACP_WORKSPACE_DIR") == str(TEST_WS_DIR)
        assert env_rn.get("ACP_WORKSPACE_DIR") == str(TEST_WS_DIR)
        assert env_rn.get("ACP_EXEC_DIR") == str(TEST_EXEC_DIR)
        notes.append("isolated STATE_DIR/ACP_EXEC_DIR/ACP_WORKSPACE_DIR rendered")
        # 3. flags explicit OFF in OFF render, ON in ON render
        for env, who in ((env_st, "state"), (env_rn, "runner")):
            assert env.get("ACP_EXEC_START") == "0", (who, env.get("ACP_EXEC_START"))
            assert env.get("ACP_EXEC_VALIDATION") == "0", \
                (who, env.get("ACP_EXEC_VALIDATION"))
        st_on, rn_on = svc(on, "state"), svc(on, "runner")
        for env, who in ((st_on["environment"], "state"),
                         (rn_on["environment"], "runner")):
            assert env.get("ACP_EXEC_START") == "1", (who, env.get("ACP_EXEC_START"))
            assert env.get("ACP_EXEC_VALIDATION") == "1"
        notes.append("ACP_EXEC_START/VALIDATION render '0' OFF, '1' ON on both services")
        # 4. web serves isolated dist-web; bridge is real code + mock child
        dv = [v for v in web.get("volumes", []) if v.get("target") == "/repo/dist-web"]
        assert dv and dv[0]["source"] == str(ROOT / "dist-web"), dv
        cmd = " ".join(bh.get("command", []))
        assert "acp-ws-bridge.mjs" in cmd and "u7_mock_acp.mjs" in cmd \
            and "--port 25901" in cmd, cmd
        assert bh.get("user") == "1001:1001"
        notes.append("web isolated dist-web; bridge-hermes uid1001 + mock ACP cmd")
        # 5. images pinned to the test tag; state reader mount present
        assert st.get("image") == "acp-ui-u7:latest"
        assert rn.get("image") == "acp-ui-u7:latest"
        assert any(v.get("target") ==
                   "/home/hermes/.cache/pragmatic-orchestration/steer"
                   and v.get("read_only")
                   for v in st.get("volumes", [])), \
            "state must mount the external porch steer dir read-only"
        notes.append("state porch steer dir mounted ro; images pinned acp-ui-u7")
        for n in notes:
            print("  PASS", n)
        return notes
    
    
    def preflight_idle(self_run_id: str | None) -> None:
        """Prove no live work would be disturbed. Read-only checks only."""
        print("preflight: live claims/doc on current state server")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(
                    f"{H.STATE_URL}/api/state/claims.json", timeout=5) as r:
                doc = json.loads(r.read())
        except Exception as e:
            raise StepError(f"live claims read failed: {e}") from e
        data = doc.get("data") or {}
        if data.get("claims") or data.get("attempts"):
            raise StepError("live claims.json not empty — refusing transition")
        print("preflight: porch delegate list --active")
        res = run([PORCH, "delegate", "list", "--active", "--json"], timeout=30)
        try:
            active = json.loads(res.stdout)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            raise StepError(f"porch active list unreadable: {e}") from e
        others = [r for r in active if r.get("run_id") != self_run_id]
        if others:
            raise StepError(
                f"active porch runs besides self: "
                f"{[r.get('run_id') for r in others]}")
        top = compose(FILES_OFF, "top", "bridge-hermes").stdout
        # The bridge's own cmd line contains "--cmd hermes acp"; a live child is
        # any process line that is NOT the bridge itself.
        children = [ln for ln in top.splitlines()[1:]
                    if ln.strip() and "acp-ws-bridge.mjs" not in ln]
        if children:
            raise StepError(
                f"bridge-hermes has live children — refusing:\n{children}")
        top_r = compose(FILES_OFF, "top", "runner").stdout
        rlines = [ln for ln in top_r.splitlines()[1:] if ln.strip()]
        if len(rlines) != 1 or "acp-runner.mjs" not in rlines[0]:
            raise StepError(f"runner has live children/jobs:\n{top_r}")
        print("preflight: claims empty, only self porch run, "
              "bridge-hermes childless, runner idle")
    
    
    def build_image() -> None:
        print("building acp-ui-u7:latest from isolated Dockerfile.node …")
        run(["docker", "build", "-f", str(ROOT / "Dockerfile.node"),
             "-t", "acp-ui-u7:latest", str(ROOT)], timeout=1800)
    
    
    def up(files, *services) -> None:
        compose(files, "up", "-d", "--no-deps", *services, timeout=600)
    
    
    def provision_test_ops() -> None:
        """Test-only ops dir+token — never the production ~/.acp-ops."""
        TEST_OPS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        os.chmod(TEST_OPS_DIR, 0o700)
        tok = TEST_OPS_DIR / "ops-token"
        if not tok.exists():
            res = run(["openssl", "rand", "-hex", "24"])
            fd = os.open(tok, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
            with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
                f.write(res.stdout.strip() + "\n")
        (TEST_OPS_DIR / "env-receipts").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        print("test ops dir ready (token 0600, dir 0700) — value never printed")
    
    
    def _restore_impl() -> int:
        rf = PRIV / "restore-acp-ui.yaml"
        ck = PRIV / "restore-acp-ui-check.json"
        if not rf.exists():
            print("restore: no generated file — regenerating from last capture")
            if restore_gen.main() != 0:
                print("FAIL  cannot regenerate restore file"); return 1
        manifest = json.loads(ck.read_text()) if ck.exists() else {}
        print("restore: up -d --no-deps scoped services on actual spec …")
        run(["docker", "compose", "-p", PROJECT, "-f", str(rf),
             "up", "-d", "--no-deps", *SCOPED], timeout=600)
        prior = manifest.get(CRON, {})
        if prior.get("status") == "running":
            print("restore: start cron (original container)")
            compose(FILES_OFF, "start", CRON)
        time.sleep(1.5)
        bad = []
        for svc in SCOPED:
            d = json.loads(run(["docker", "inspect", f"{PROJECT}-{svc}-1"]).stdout)[0]
            ok = d["State"].get("Status") == "running" \
                and d["Image"] == manifest.get(svc, {}).get("image")
            if not ok:
                bad.append((svc, d["State"].get("Status"), d["Image"][:19]))
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{H.STATE_URL}/health", timeout=5) as r:
                hdir = json.loads(r.read()).get("dir")
            if hdir != LIVE_STATE_DIR:
                bad.append(("state-health-dir", hdir))
        except Exception as e:
            bad.append(("state-health", str(e)))
        if bad:
            print("FAIL  restore verification:", bad); return 1
        print("restore: scoped services back on captured actual spec, "
              "state dir = live")
        return 0
    
    
    def restore() -> int:
        try:
            return _restore_impl()
        except StepError as e:
            print(f"FAIL  restore raised: {e}")
            return 1
    
    
    def _on_signal(signum, _frame):
        if _transition_began:
            print(f"\nsignal {signum} during transition — restoring first")
            _restore_impl()
        sys.exit(128 + signum)
    
    
    def main() -> int:
        global _transition_began
        ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        ap.add_argument("mode", choices=["plan", "apply", "on", "off", "seed",
                                         "restore", "verify"])
        ap.add_argument("--self-run-id", default=None,
                        help="porch run id of this very session (active filter)")
        args = ap.parse_args()
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _on_signal)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _on_signal)
    
        if args.mode == "plan":
            capture_all()
            print(f"captured actual specs → {PRIV}/inspect-*.json")
            if restore_gen.main() != 0:
                return 1
            render_check()
            seed_marker()
            seed_sandbox()
            print("\nplan complete — review render-*.json and restore-acp-ui.yaml")
            return 0
    
        if args.mode == "restore":
            return restore()
    
        if args.mode == "verify":
            manifest = json.loads(
                (PRIV / "restore-acp-ui-check.json").read_text())
            bad = []
            for svc in SCOPED + [CRON]:
                d = json.loads(
                    run(["docker", "inspect", f"{PROJECT}-{svc}-1"]).stdout)[0]
                exp = manifest.get(svc)
                if not exp:
                    continue
                cur_env = restore_gen.digest(d["Config"].get("Env") or [])
                cur_m = restore_gen.digest(
                    [[m["Source"], m["Destination"], m.get("Mode") or "rw"]
                     for m in (d.get("Mounts") or [])])
                for k, cur in (
                    ("image", d["Image"]),
                    ("user", d["Config"].get("User") or ""),
                    ("command", d["Config"].get("Cmd")),
                    ("entrypoint", d["Config"].get("Entrypoint")),
                    ("workingDir", d["Config"].get("WorkingDir") or ""),
                    ("networkMode", d["HostConfig"].get("NetworkMode")),
                    ("restart",
                     (d["HostConfig"].get("RestartPolicy") or {}).get("Name")),
                    ("env_sha256", cur_env), ("mounts_sha256", cur_m),
                ):
                    if exp.get(k) != cur:
                        bad.append((svc, k))
                if svc in manifest and exp.get("status") == "running" \
                        and d["State"].get("Status") != "running":
                    bad.append((svc, "status"))
            if bad:
                print("FAIL  drift vs captured actual:", bad)
                return 1
            print("verify: all scoped+cron specs match the captured actual spec")
            return 0
    
        if args.mode == "seed":
            H.verify_isolation()
            status, body = H.seed_doc("projects.json", {
                "version": 1,
                "projects": [
                    {"id": "u7-proj-a", "name": "u7-a",
                     "path": str(SANDBOX / "proj-a"),
                     "createdAt": int(time.time() * 1000)},
                    {"id": "u7-proj-b", "name": "u7-b",
                     "path": str(SANDBOX / "proj-b"),
                     "createdAt": int(time.time() * 1000)},
                ],
                "activeProjectId": "u7-proj-a",
            })
            print("projects.json:", status)
            now = int(time.time() * 1000)
            status2, body2 = H.seed_doc("board.json", {
                "version": 2,
                "cards": [{
                    "id": "u7-card-solo", "title": "U7 managed smoke card",
                    "description": "managed execution fixture",
                    "agent": "", "priority": "normal", "acceptance": "",
                    "verification": "", "links": [], "session": None,
                    "blocked": False, "blockedReason": "", "cancelled": False,
                    "touches": [], "dependsOn": [], "blocks": [],
                    "conflictsWith": [], "stage": "backlog", "status": "todo",
                    "statusByStage": {}, "order": 0, "project": "u7-proj-a",
                    "createdAt": now, "updatedAt": now,
                }],
            })
            print("board.json:", status2)
            return 0 if status == 200 and status2 == 200 else 1
    
        # ---- apply / on / off -------------------------------------------------
        if args.mode == "apply":
            capture_all()                      # fresh actual spec at apply time
            if restore_gen.main() != 0:
                return 1
            render_check()
            seed_marker()
            seed_sandbox()
            preflight_idle(args.self_run_id)
            provision_test_ops()
            build_image()
            _transition_began = True
            try:
                print("stop cron (status captured)")
                compose(FILES_OFF, "stop", CRON)
                print("up -d --no-deps state runner web bridge-hermes (OFF)")
                up(FILES_OFF, *SCOPED)
                time.sleep(1.0)
                H.require_stack(services=("state", "web", "runner"))
                for svc in ("bridge-hermes",):
                    if not H.service_running(svc):
                        raise StepError(f"{svc} not running after transition")
                write_private(PRIV / "transition-receipt.json", json.dumps({
                    "phase": "off", "at": time.time(),
                    "stateDir": str(TEST_STATE_DIR),
                }, indent=2))
                print("transition complete — OFF stack live on fixed ports")
            except BaseException:
                print("transition failed — restoring before exit")
                _restore_impl()
                raise
            return 0
    
        if args.mode == "on":
            H.verify_isolation()
            print("up -d --no-deps state runner (ON overlay)")
            up(FILES_ON, "state", "runner")
            time.sleep(1.0)
            H.verify_isolation()
            print("ON phase live — ACP_EXEC_START=1 ACP_EXEC_VALIDATION=1")
            return 0
    
        if args.mode == "off":
            H.verify_isolation()
            up(FILES_OFF, "state", "runner")
            print("OFF phase restored")
            return 0
    
        return 2
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """U7 transition driver — the ONLY path the scoped test transition runs.
    
    Modes:
      plan     read-only + private files: capture actual specs (refused while
               the test stack owns the ports — a capture then would record the
               TEST spec as "actual" and corrupt restore), generate the restore
               compose file + digest manifest, render both overlay configs with
               assertions, seed the on-disk test marker and the git sandbox.
      apply    capture -> render-check -> marker/sandbox -> preflight ->
               build -> RE-preflight -> stop cron -> up -d --no-deps scoped
               services (OFF) -> verify isolation. --self-run-id is required;
               any failure or signal runs restore() first, then exits.
      on       stack compose.u7-on.yaml; recreate state+runner (managed ON).
      off      recreate state+runner back to the OFF overlay.
      seed     HTTP-seed test fixtures — only after marker-verified isolation.
      restore  Compose-driven return to the captured actual spec; each scoped
               service returns to its captured prior status (all were running
               at capture); cron resumes via `start` (original container).
      verify   compare live inspect to the manifest privately — image/user/
               entrypoint/cmd/wd/network/restart + sha256 of SORTED env and
               mounts (ordering differences are not drift).
    
    Guards (AGENTS.md): single acp-ui project, fixed ports, --no-deps only, no
    --remove-orphans, no `down`, no bare node/python servers, no second stack.
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import json
    import os
    import secrets
    import signal
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import time
    import urllib.request
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
    import _e2e_compose_harness as H  # noqa: E402
    import u7_restore_override as restore_gen  # noqa: E402
    
    PRIV = Path(os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/acp-u7-devin"))
    PROJECT = "acp-ui"
    SCOPED = ["state", "runner", "web", "bridge-hermes"]
    CRON = "cron"
    TEST_STATE_DIR = Path("/home/hermes/.hermes/acp-ui-state-u7")
    TEST_EXEC_DIR = TEST_STATE_DIR / "execution"
    TEST_WS_DIR = Path("/home/hermes/projects/.acp-workspaces-u7")
    TEST_OPS_DIR = Path("/home/hermes/.acp-ops-u7")
    SANDBOX = Path("/home/hermes/projects/acp-u7-sandbox")
    LIVE_STATE_DIR = "/home/hermes/.hermes/acp-ui-state"
    TEST_IMAGE = "acp-ui-u7:latest"
    PORCH = os.path.expanduser(
        "~/.pi/agent/skills/pragmatic-orchestration/scripts/porch")
    
    FILES_OFF = [ROOT / "compose.yaml", ROOT / "compose.u7.yaml"]
    FILES_ON = FILES_OFF + [ROOT / "compose.u7-on.yaml"]
    FILES_RESTORE = [PRIV / "restore-acp-ui.yaml"]
    
    
    class StepError(RuntimeError):
        pass
    
    
    def run(cmd: list[str], timeout=120.0, ok_codes=(0,), **kw) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
        res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True,
                             timeout=timeout, **kw)
        if res.returncode not in ok_codes:
            raise StepError(
                f"{' '.join(map(str, cmd))} -> exit {res.returncode}\n"
                f"{res.stdout[-2000:]}\n{res.stderr[-2000:]}")
        return res
    
    
    def compose(files, *args, timeout=120.0):
        cmd = ["docker", "compose", "-p", PROJECT]
        for f in files:
            cmd += ["-f", str(f)]
        return run(cmd + list(args), timeout=timeout)
    
    
    def compose_json(files, *args, timeout=120.0):
        return json.loads(compose(files, *args, timeout=timeout).stdout)
    
    
    def write_private(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
        PRIV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        os.chmod(PRIV, 0o700)
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
            f.write(text)
    
    
    def inspect_svc(service: str) -> dict:
        return json.loads(
            run(["docker", "inspect", f"{PROJECT}-{service}-1"]).stdout)[0]
    
    
    def on_test_stack() -> bool:
        """True when the state container already runs the test spec — baseline
        captures must then be preserved, never overwritten."""
        try:
            d = inspect_svc("state")
        except StepError:
            return False
        env = {e.split("=", 1)[0]: e.split("=", 1)[1]

    def proc_rows(service: str) -> list[str]:
        """Actual process rows inside the container via `docker top` (stable
        columns: UID PID PPID C STIME TTY TIME CMD — no service/name sections)."""
        out = run(["docker", "top", f"{PROJECT}-{service}-1"]).stdout
        rows = []
        for ln in out.splitlines()[1:]:
            if ln.strip():
                rows.append(ln)
        return rows
    
    
    def preflight_idle(self_run_id: str | None) -> None:
        """Prove no live work would be disturbed. Read-only checks only."""
        print("preflight: live claims/doc on current state server")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(
                    f"{H.STATE_URL}/api/state/claims.json", timeout=5) as r:
                doc = json.loads(r.read())
        except Exception as e:
            raise StepError(f"live claims read failed: {e}") from e
        data = doc.get("data") or {}
        if data.get("claims") or data.get("attempts"):
            raise StepError("live claims.json not empty — refusing transition")
        print("preflight: porch delegate list --active")
        res = run([PORCH, "delegate", "list", "--active", "--json"], timeout=30)
        try:
            active = json.loads(res.stdout)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            raise StepError(f"porch active list unreadable: {e}") from e
        others = [r for r in active if r.get("run_id") != self_run_id]
        if others:
            raise StepError(
                f"active porch runs besides self: "
                f"{[r.get('run_id') for r in others]}")
        # bridge-hermes: the bridge line itself contains "--cmd hermes acp" in
        # its CMD; a live agent child is any OTHER process row.
        bh = [ln for ln in proc_rows("bridge-hermes")
              if "acp-ws-bridge.mjs" not in ln]
        if bh:
            raise StepError(
                f"bridge-hermes has live children — refusing:\n{bh}")
        rn = proc_rows("runner")
        if len(rn) != 1 or "acp-runner.mjs" not in rn[0]:
            raise StepError(f"runner has live children/jobs:\n{rn}")
        print("preflight: claims empty, only self porch run, "
              "bridge-hermes childless, runner idle")

        print(f"building {TEST_IMAGE} from isolated Dockerfile.node …")
        run(["docker", "build", "-f", str(ROOT / "Dockerfile.node"),
             "-t", TEST_IMAGE, str(ROOT)], timeout=1800)
    
    
    def up(files, *services) -> None:
        compose(files, "up", "-d", "--no-deps", *services, timeout=600)
    
    
    def provision_test_ops() -> None:
        """Test-only ops dir+token — never the production ~/.acp-ops."""
        TEST_OPS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        os.chmod(TEST_OPS_DIR, 0o700)
        tok = TEST_OPS_DIR / "ops-token"
        if not tok.exists():
            res = run(["openssl", "rand", "-hex", "24"])
            fd = os.open(tok, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
            with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
                f.write(res.stdout.strip() + "\n")
        (TEST_OPS_DIR / "env-receipts").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        print("test ops dir ready (token 0600, dir 0700) — value never printed")
    
    
    def _manifest() -> dict:
        ck = PRIV / "restore-acp-ui-check.json"
        return json.loads(ck.read_text()) if ck.exists() else {}
    
    
    def diff_against_manifest() -> list:
        """Private full-manifest comparison — returns (service, field) drift."""
        manifest = _manifest()
        bad = []
        for svc in SCOPED + [CRON]:
            exp = manifest.get(svc)
            if not exp:
                continue
            try:
                d = inspect_svc(svc)
            except StepError:
                bad.append((svc, "container-missing"))
                continue
            cfg, host = d["Config"], d["HostConfig"]
            cur_env = restore_gen.digest(sorted(cfg.get("Env") or []))
            cur_m = restore_gen.digest(sorted(
                [m["Source"], m["Destination"], m.get("Mode") or "rw"]
                for m in (d.get("Mounts") or [])))
            cur = {
                "image": d["Image"],
                "user": cfg.get("User") or "",
                "command": cfg.get("Cmd"),
                "entrypoint": cfg.get("Entrypoint"),
                "workingDir": cfg.get("WorkingDir") or "",
                "networkMode": host.get("NetworkMode"),
                "restart": (host.get("RestartPolicy") or {}).get("Name"),
                "env_sha256": cur_env,
                "mounts_sha256": cur_m,
            }
            for k, v in cur.items():
                if exp.get(k) != v:
                    bad.append((svc, k))
            if exp.get("status") == "running" \
                    and d["State"].get("Status") != "running":
                bad.append((svc, "status"))
        return bad
    
    
    def _restore_impl() -> int:
        rf = PRIV / "restore-acp-ui.yaml"
        if not rf.exists():
            print("restore: no generated file — regenerating from last capture")
            if restore_gen.main([]) != 0:
                print("FAIL  cannot regenerate restore file")
                return 1
        manifest = _manifest()
        print("restore: up -d --no-deps scoped services on captured actual spec")
        run(["docker", "compose", "-p", PROJECT, "-f", str(rf),
             "up", "-d", "--no-deps", *SCOPED], timeout=600)
        for svc in SCOPED:  # captured-not-running services must stay down
            if manifest.get(svc, {}).get("status") != "running":
                compose(FILES_RESTORE, "stop", svc)
        if manifest.get(CRON, {}).get("status") == "running":
            print("restore: start cron (original container)")
            compose(FILES_OFF, "start", CRON)
        time.sleep(1.5)
        bad = diff_against_manifest()
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{H.STATE_URL}/health", timeout=5) as r:
                hdir = json.loads(r.read()).get("dir")
            if hdir != LIVE_STATE_DIR:
                bad.append(("state-health-dir", hdir))
        except Exception as e:
            bad.append(("state-health", str(e)))
        if bad:
            print("FAIL  restore verification:", bad)
            return 1
        print("restore: scoped services back on captured actual spec, "
              "state dir = live")
        return 0
    
    
    def restore() -> int:
        try:
            return _restore_impl()
        except StepError as e:
            print(f"FAIL  restore raised: {e}")
            return 1
    
    
    def _on_signal(signum, _frame):
        if _transition_began:
            print(f"\nsignal {signum} during transition — restoring first")
            _restore_impl()
        sys.exit(128 + signum)
    
    
    _transition_began = False

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """u7_run.py — whole-sequence orchestrator for the U7 test window.
    
    Owns the transition lifecycle across ALL phases: any phase failure, suite
    nonzero exit, timeout, or signal ends in restore()+verify before the
    process exits — the live stack never stays on the test config unattended.
    
      python3 scripts/u7_run.py --self-run-id <id> [--phases a,b,c] [--keep-going]
    
    Phase registry maps a name to a subprocess command run with a bounded
    timeout; every phase prints a one-line receipt appended to
    ~/.cache/acp-u7-devin/u7-run.log. Phases run in the fixed order below;
    `transition` is implicit (apply in, restore out) and is not a phase.
    
    Environment/mutation safety: this script performs service actions ONLY via
    scripts/u7_transition.py (which owns the actual compose invocations and
    pre-mutation idle preflights). No service action runs without the
    transition driver, and apply itself requires the manager-cleared window.
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import json
    import os
    import signal
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import time
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    PRIV = Path(os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/acp-u7-devin"))
    TRANSITION = ROOT / "scripts" / "u7_transition.py"
    LOG = PRIV / "u7-run.log"
    
    # name -> (argv-suffix, timeout seconds). Suites are added as they are
    # implemented; each is a plain subprocess so a hang is bounded and a
    # failure cannot escape the finally-restore below.
    PHASES: dict[str, tuple[list[str], int]] = {
        "off-smoke":  (["off-smoke"], 900),
        "on":         (["on"], 300),
        "api-flow":   (["suite", "u7_api_flow"], 1800),
        "acp":        (["suite", "u7_acp_bridge"], 600),
        "browser":    (["suite", "u7_browser"], 3600),
        "crash":      (["suite", "u7_crash"], 1800),
        "u5-incident":(["suite", "u5_incident"], 1200),
    }
    DEFAULT_ORDER = list(PHASES)
    
    
    def log(line: str) -> None:
        PRIV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(LOG, "a") as f:
            f.write(f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())} {line}\n")
        print(line)
    
    
    def transition(*args: str, timeout: int = 900) -> int:
        return subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(TRANSITION), *args],
            timeout=timeout).returncode
    
    
    def run_suite(name: str) -> int:
        spec = ROOT / "scripts" / f"{name}.py"
        if not spec.exists():
            log(f"FAIL suite {name}: {spec} missing")
            return 2
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(spec)],
                              timeout=3600).returncode
    
    
    def _dead(_sig, _frm):
        # Restore before exiting on any cancellation — never leave the test
        # stack running after this orchestrator is gone.
        transition("restore")
        sys.exit(2)
    
    
    def main() -> int:
        ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        ap.add_argument("--self-run-id", required=True)
        ap.add_argument("--phases", default=",".join(DEFAULT_ORDER))
        ap.add_argument("--keep-going", action="store_true",
                        help="continue to next phase after a failure "
                             "(restore still happens at the end)")
        args = ap.parse_args()
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _dead)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _dead)
    
        wanted = [p for p in args.phases.split(",") if p]
        for p in wanted:
            if p not in PHASES:
                print(f"unknown phase {p!r}; known: {', '.join(DEFAULT_ORDER)}")
                return 2
    
        results: dict[str, int | str] = {}
        try:
            log("== u7 run: apply (OFF transition) ==")
            rc = transition("apply", "--self-run-id", args.self_run_id)
            results["apply"] = rc
            if rc != 0:
                raise SystemExit(rc)
            for name in wanted:
                spec, tmo = PHASES[name]
                log(f"== phase {name} ==")
                try:
                    if spec[0] == "suite":
                        rc = run_suite(spec[1])
                    else:
                        rc = transition(spec[0], timeout=tmo)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    rc = "timeout"
                results[name] = rc
                log(f"phase {name}: {rc}")
                if rc != 0 and not args.keep_going:
                    break
        finally:
            log("== u7 run: restore ==")
            rc = transition("restore", timeout=900)
            results["restore"] = rc
            rcv = transition("verify", timeout=300)
            results["verify"] = rcv
            write_private = PRIV / "u7-run-result.json"
            fd = os.open(write_private, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC,
                         0o600)
            with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
                json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
            log(f"results: {json.dumps(results)}")
        failed = {k: v for k, v in results.items() if v not in (0, "0")}
        return 1 if failed else 0
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """u7_run.py — whole-sequence orchestrator for the U7 test window.
    
    Owns the transition lifecycle across ALL phases:
    
      1. pre-validate every requested phase target (missing suite files fail
         BEFORE any service change — a missing required suite never becomes a
         skip/pass),
      2. apply (OFF transition) via scripts/u7_transition.py,
      3. run requested phases in fixed order — each a tracked subprocess in
         its OWN process group, bounded by the phase's real timeout,
      4. restore() then verify() in finally — on success, failure, timeout,
         or signal. If the restore itself fails, verify+results still run and
         the report is written truthfully.
    
    Subprocess ownership: every spawned child gets `start_new_session=True`
    so it heads its own process group; timeout/signal drains exactly that
    group via killpg (direct child AND any browser/docker grandchildren it
    spawned) before restore — restore never races a live test driver that
    could still POST to the fixed endpoints. Only our own group is ever
    signalled — never the manager's session or unrelated jobs.
    
      python3 scripts/u7_run.py --self-run-id <id> [--phases a,b,c]
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import json
    import os
    import signal
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import time
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    PRIV = Path(os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/acp-u7-devin"))
    TRANSITION = ROOT / "scripts" / "u7_transition.py"
    LOG = PRIV / "u7-run.log"
    
    # name -> (kind, target, timeout seconds)
    #   kind "transition" -> python3 u7_transition.py <target>
    #   kind "suite"      -> python3|node <repo>/scripts/<target>
    PHASES: dict[str, tuple[str, str, int]] = {
        "off-smoke":    ("suite",      "u7_off_smoke.py",   600),
        "on":           ("transition", "on",                300),
        "api-flow":     ("suite",      "u7_api_flow.py",    1800),
        "acp":          ("suite",      "u7_acp_bridge.mjs", 600),
        "browser":      ("suite",      "u7_browser.py",     3600),
        "crash":        ("suite",      "u7_crash.py",       1800),
        "u5-incident":  ("suite",      "u5_incident.py",    1200),
        "off":          ("transition", "off",               300),
    }
    DEFAULT_ORDER = [
        "off-smoke", "on", "api-flow", "acp", "browser", "crash",
        "u5-incident", "off",
    ]
    
    _results: dict = {}
    _child: subprocess.Popen | None = None
    _restoring = False
    
    
    def log(line: str) -> None:
        PRIV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(LOG, "a") as f:
            f.write(f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())} {line}\n")
        print(line, flush=True)
    
    
    def drain_child(kill: bool) -> None:
        """Terminate the tracked subprocess GROUP, not just the direct child —
        a suite's own children (playwright browsers, docker exec) must not
        outlive it while restore mutates the stack they talk to."""
        global _child
        p = _child
        if p is None or p.poll() is not None:
            return
        if kill:
            try:
                os.killpg(os.getpgid(p.pid), signal.SIGKILL)
            except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
                pass
        try:
            p.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            try:
                os.killpg(os.getpgid(p.pid), signal.SIGKILL)
            except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
                pass
            p.wait(timeout=10)
    
    
    def spawn(argv: list[str], timeout: int) -> int | str:
        global _child
        _child = subprocess.Popen(argv, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            return _child.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            drain_child(kill=True)
            return "timeout"
        finally:
            _child = None
    
    
    def restore_and_verify() -> None:
        """Best-effort restore + verify; a restore failure is recorded
        truthfully rather than aborting the report path."""
        global _restoring
        if _restoring:
            return
        _restoring = True
        try:
            drain_child(kill=True)          # never restore under a live suite
            log("== restore ==")
            try:
                _results["restore"] = spawn(
                    [sys.executable, str(TRANSITION), "restore"], 900)
            except Exception as e:          # process-level failure
                _results["restore"] = f"error:{e!r}"
            log("== verify ==")
            try:
                _results["verify"] = spawn(
                    [sys.executable, str(TRANSITION), "verify"], 300)
            except Exception as e:
                _results["verify"] = f"error:{e!r}"
        finally:
            _restoring = False
    
    
    def _dead(signum, _frame):
        log(f"signal {signum} — drain owned child group, then restore")
        try:
            restore_and_verify()
        finally:
            _persist()
        os._exit(128 + signum)
    
    
    def _persist() -> None:
        PRIV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fd = os.open(PRIV / "u7-run-result.json",
                     os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
            json.dump(_results, f, indent=2)
        log(f"results: {json.dumps(_results)}")
    
    
    def main() -> int:
        ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        ap.add_argument("--self-run-id", required=True)
        ap.add_argument("--phases", default=",".join(DEFAULT_ORDER))
        ap.add_argument("--keep-going", action="store_true")
        args = ap.parse_args()
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _dead)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _dead)
    
        wanted = [p for p in args.phases.split(",") if p]
        # Validate EVERY phase target before any service change — a missing
        # suite fails fast with the stack untouched, never a silent skip.
        for name in wanted:
            spec = PHASES.get(name)
            if spec is None:
                print(f"unknown phase {name!r}; known: {', '.join(PHASES)}")
                return 2
            kind, target, _tmo = spec
            if kind == "suite":
                path = ROOT / "scripts" / target
                if not path.is_file():
                    print(f"REFUSE: phase {name!r} suite file {path} missing — "
                          f"no service touched")
                    return 2
            elif kind != "transition":
                print(f"unknown phase kind {kind!r}")
                return 2
    
        try:
            log("== apply (OFF transition) ==")
            rc = spawn([sys.executable, str(TRANSITION), "apply",
                        "--self-run-id", args.self_run_id], 1800)
            _results["apply"] = rc
            if rc != 0:
                return 1
            for name in wanted:
                kind, target, tmo = PHASES[name]
                log(f"== phase {name} ({kind}:{target}, tmo={tmo}s) ==")
                if kind == "transition":
                    argv = [sys.executable, str(TRANSITION), target]
                else:
                    interp = "node" if target.endswith(".mjs") else sys.executable
                    argv = [interp, str(ROOT / "scripts" / target)]
                rc = spawn(argv, tmo)
                _results[name] = rc
                log(f"phase {name}: {rc}")
                if rc != 0 and not args.keep_going:
                    break
        finally:
            restore_and_verify()
            _persist()
        bad = {k: v for k, v in _results.items() if v != 0}
        return 1 if bad else 0
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """u7_off_smoke.py — OFF-phase proof on the transitioned isolated stack.
    
    Asserts, over real HTTP against the isolated state service (fixed port
    25900, marker+dir verified):
    
      1. default-OFF gate: `start`, `continue` -> 501 gate=ACP_EXEC_START;
         `accept_result` -> 501 gate=ACP_EXEC_VALIDATION.
      2. non-gated user commands still work: enable, attach_document,
         approve_requirements, approve_plan, save_preset — the OFF flag only
         blocks LAUNCH/VALIDATION, not card setup.
      3. no launch happens while OFF: after full setup, aggregate has zero
         runs and runner stays idle (no attempt spawned — the flag is the
         only thing between approval and a real agent process).
      4. legacy surface unchanged: /api/state/board.json + claims.json shape,
         /api/porch/runs now returns the REAL external porch registry via the
         new read-only steer mount (the pre-transition deployment returned an
         empty list — regression boundary documented in the U7 report).
      5. isolation marker: the seeded nonce reads back byte-identical.
    
    Seeds its own fixture card (u7-card-off) + project — never touches a
    live card. Every state-changing call re-verifies isolation first.
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import json
    import sys
    import time
    import urllib.request
    import uuid
    from pathlib import Path
    
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
    import _e2e_compose_harness as H  # noqa: E402
    
    CARD = "u7-card-off"
    PROJ = "u7-proj-a"
    SANDBOX = Path("/home/hermes/projects/acp-u7-sandbox")
    FAILED = []
    
    
    def check(name, cond, detail=""):
        tag = "PASS" if cond else "FAIL"
        print(f"{tag}  {name} {detail}")
        if not cond:
            FAILED.append(f"{name}: {detail}")
    
    
    def cmd(card_id, type_, payload=None, expect=None):
        """POST a user command with isolation re-verified first."""
        H.verify_isolation()
        body = {
            "commandId": f"u7off-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            "type": type_,
            "payload": payload or {},
        }
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{H.STATE_URL}/api/execution/cards/{card_id}/commands",
            data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
            headers={"content-type": "application/json"},
            method="POST")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
                status, out = r.status, json.loads(r.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            status, out = e.code, json.loads(e.read())
        if expect is not None and status != expect:
            raise AssertionError(f"{type_} -> {status} (want {expect}): {out}")
        return status, out
    
    
    def get(path):
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{H.STATE_URL}{path}", timeout=10) as r:
            return json.loads(r.read())
    
    
    def seed_fixture() -> None:
        H.verify_isolation()
        # project registry — isolated sandbox path

                "id": PROJ, "name": "u7-a",
                "path": str(SANDBOX / "proj-a"),
                "createdAt": int(time.time() * 1000),
            }],
            "activeProjectId": PROJ,
        })
        check("seed projects.json", status == 200)
        now = int(time.time() * 1000)
        status, _ = H.seed_doc("board.json", {
            "version": 2,
            "cards": [{
                "id": CARD, "title": "U7 OFF gate card",
                "description": "off-phase fixture", "agent": "",
                "priority": "normal", "acceptance": "", "verification": "",
                "links": [], "session": None, "blocked": False,
                "blockedReason": "", "cancelled": False, "touches": [],
                "dependsOn": [], "blocks": [], "conflictsWith": [],
                "stage": "backlog", "status": "todo", "statusByStage": {},
                "order": 0, "project": PROJ,
                "createdAt": now, "updatedAt": now,
            }],
        })
        check("seed board.json", status == 200)
    
    
    def main() -> int:
        print("== u7_off_smoke: isolation ==")
        ok, detail = H.verify_isolation_detail()
        check("isolation marker+dir", ok, detail)
    
        print("== legacy surface ==")
        h = get("/health")
        check("health dir is isolated", h.get("dir") == str(H.TEST_STATE_DIR),
              h.get("dir"))
        board = get("/api/state/board.json")
        check("board.json legacy shape",
              board.get("name") == "board.json" and "data" in board)
        claims = get("/api/state/claims.json")
        check("claims.json legacy shape", "data" in claims)
        runs = get("/api/porch/runs")
        n = len(runs.get("runs") or [])
        check("external porch runs visible via ro steer mount", n >= 1,
              f"runs={n} (pre-transition deployment returned 0)")
        assert not any(r.get("managed") for r in runs.get("runs", [])), \

        check("enable ok (not launch-gated)", st == 200 and body.get("ok"),

        st, body = cmd(CARD, "start")
        check("start gated 501/ACP_EXEC_START",
              st == 501 and body.get("gate") == "ACP_EXEC_START",
              f"{st} {body.get('code')} {body.get('gate')}")
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "continue")
        check("continue gated 501/ACP_EXEC_START",

              f"{st} {body.get('code')}")
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "accept_result",

    async function cmdStop(_ctx, aggregate, payload, now, ctx = _ctx) {

        const cur = currentRun(aggregate);

      for (const r of aggregate.runs) {

      }
      bumpControl(aggregate, now);

        refreshProjection: true,
        result: { status: 'stopping', stoppedRuns, cancelPending },
      };
    }
    
    async function cmdChangeRequirements(ctx, aggregate, payload, now) {
      // Requirements changed: invalidate BOTH approvals (the plan was bound to
      // the old requirements) AND set the durable stop intent on anything live —
      // one atomic commit. No new work may be issued until the new inputs are
      // attached and re-approved.
      const { stoppedRuns, cancelPending } =
        applyStopIntent(aggregate, now, { by: 'user', reason: 'requirements_changed' });
      for (const r of aggregate.runs || []) {
        if (r && stoppedRuns.includes(r.id)) stageRun(aggregate, r, ctx);
      }
      const invalidated = [];
      if (aggregate.approvals.requirements) {
        aggregate.approvals.requirements = null;
        invalidated.push('requirements');
      }
      if (aggregate.approvals.plan) {
        aggregate.approvals.plan = null;
        invalidated.push('plan');
      }
      aggregate.requirementsChangedAt = now;
      bumpControl(aggregate, now);
      return {
        aggregate,
        refreshProjection: true,
        result: {
          requirementsChanged: true,
          invalidatedApprovals: invalidated,
          stoppedRuns,
          cancelPending,
        },
      };
    }

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """u7_run.py — whole-sequence orchestrator for the U7 test window.
    
    Lifecycle ownership is explicit and evidence-bound:
    
      * A fresh `window` nonce is generated per invocation and passed to every
        transition call. The transition driver records `window-<nonce>.json`
        BEFORE the first scoped mutation (`stop cron`/`up`). restore() runs
        ONLY when that file exists — a refused apply (idle-preflight block,
        already-on-test-stack refusal, build failure) leaves no window file,
        so restore becomes a recorded no-op and never recreates live services
        over a window that owned nothing. Stale receipts from older windows
        can't trigger anything: the nonce is per-run.
    
      * Every spawned child heads its OWN process group (start_new_session).
        The group is tracked by PGID (= child pid), independent of the leader's
        lifetime — a suite that exits while a browser/`docker exec` grandchild
        survives is still drained: after EVERY spawn (normal exit, nonzero,
        timeout) the group is probe-killed (killpg 0 -> TERM -> KILL). Restore
        never runs while a group this window spawned is still alive, so no
        orphaned test driver can POST to the fixed endpoints mid-restore.
    
      * Signals: drain the owned group, then restore-if-owned, persist, exit.
    
      python3 scripts/u7_run.py --self-run-id <id> [--phases a,b,c]
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import argparse
    import json
    import os
    import secrets
    import signal
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import time
    from pathlib import Path
    
    ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    PRIV = Path(os.path.expanduser("~/.cache/acp-u7-devin"))
    TRANSITION = ROOT / "scripts" / "u7_transition.py"
    LOG = PRIV / "u7-run.log"
    
    # name -> (kind, target, timeout seconds)
    #   kind "transition" -> python3 u7_transition.py <target>
    #   kind "suite"      -> python3|node <repo>/scripts/<target>
    PHASES: dict[str, tuple[str, str, int]] = {
        "off-smoke":    ("suite",      "u7_off_smoke.py",   600),
        "on":           ("transition", "on",                300),
        "api-flow":     ("suite",      "u7_api_flow.py",    1800),
        "acp":          ("suite",      "u7_acp_bridge.mjs", 600),
        "browser":      ("suite",      "u7_browser.py",     3600),
        "crash":        ("suite",      "u7_crash.py",       1800),
        "u5-incident":  ("suite",      "u5_incident.py",    1200),
        "off":          ("transition", "off",               300),
    }
    DEFAULT_ORDER = [
        "off-smoke", "on", "api-flow", "acp", "browser", "crash",
        "u5-incident", "off",
    ]
    
    _results: dict = {}
    _pgid: int | None = None        # owned process group of the running spawn
    _restoring = False
    _window = ""
    
    
    def log(line: str) -> None:
        PRIV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(LOG, "a") as f:
            f.write(f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())} {line}\n")
        print(line, flush=True)
    
    
    def group_alive(pgid: int) -> bool:
        try:
            os.killpg(pgid, 0)
            return True
        except ProcessLookupError:
            return False
        except PermissionError:
            return True
    
    
    def drain_group() -> None:
        """Terminate the tracked process GROUP — the suite leader may already
        be dead while a browser/`docker exec` grandchild still holds the pgid;
        ownership ends only when the group itself is empty. Only ever signals
        the group this window spawned (its own start_new_session pgid)."""
        global _pgid
        pg = _pgid
        _pgid = None
        if pg is None:
            return
        if not group_alive(pg):
            return
        try:
            os.killpg(pg, signal.SIGTERM)
        except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
            return
        for _ in range(30):                     # up to ~3s for a clean exit
            if not group_alive(pg):
                return
            time.sleep(0.1)
        if group_alive(pg):
            try:
                os.killpg(pg, signal.SIGKILL)
            except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
                pass
            for _ in range(30):
                if not group_alive(pg):
                    break
                time.sleep(0.1)
    
    
    def spawn(argv: list[str], timeout: int) -> int | str:
        """Run a phase child in its own process group; ALWAYS drain that group
        afterwards (leader exit does not imply group exit)."""
        global _pgid
        p = subprocess.Popen(argv, start_new_session=True)
        _pgid = p.pid                           # leader pid IS the new pgid
        try:
            rc = p.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            rc = "timeout"
        finally:
            try:
                p.wait(timeout=2)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                pass
            drain_group()
        return rc
    
    
    def window_mutated() -> bool:
        return bool(_window) and (PRIV / f"window-{_window}.json").exists()
    
    
    def restore_and_verify() -> None:
        global _restoring
        if _restoring:
            return
        _restoring = True
        try:
            drain_group()                       # never restore under live spawn
            if not window_mutated():
                _results["restore"] = "skipped:no-window-mutation"
                _results["verify"] = "skipped"
                log("restore skipped — this window never mutated the stack")
                return
            log("== restore ==")
            try:
                _results["restore"] = spawn(
                    [sys.executable, str(TRANSITION), "restore"], 900)
            except Exception as e:
                _results["restore"] = f"error:{e!r}"
            log("== verify ==")
            try:
                _results["verify"] = spawn(
                    [sys.executable, str(TRANSITION), "verify"], 300)
            except Exception as e:
                _results["verify"] = f"error:{e!r}"
        finally:
            _restoring = False
    
    
    def _dead(signum, _frame):
        log(f"signal {signum} — drain owned group, restore-if-owned, exit")
        try:
            restore_and_verify()
        finally:
            _persist()
        os._exit(128 + signum)
    
    
    def _persist() -> None:
        PRIV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fd = os.open(PRIV / "u7-run-result.json",
                     os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
            json.dump({**_results, "window": _window}, f, indent=2)
        log(f"results: {json.dumps(_results)}")
    
    
    def main() -> int:
        global _window
        ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
        ap.add_argument("--self-run-id", required=True)
        ap.add_argument("--phases", default=",".join(DEFAULT_ORDER))
        ap.add_argument("--keep-going", action="store_true")
        args = ap.parse_args()
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, _dead)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _dead)
    
        wanted = [p for p in args.phases.split(",") if p]
        # Validate EVERY phase target before any service change — a missing
        # suite fails fast with the stack untouched, never a silent skip.
        for name in wanted:
            spec = PHASES.get(name)
            if spec is None:
                print(f"unknown phase {name!r}; known: {', '.join(PHASES)}")
                return 2
            kind, target, _tmo = spec
            if kind == "suite":
                path = ROOT / "scripts" / target
                if not path.is_file():
                    print(f"REFUSE: phase {name!r} suite file {path} missing — "
                          f"no service touched")
                    return 2
            elif kind != "transition":
                print(f"unknown phase kind {kind!r}")
                return 2
    
        _window = secrets.token_hex(8)
        try:
            log(f"== apply (OFF transition) window={_window} ==")
            rc = spawn([sys.executable, str(TRANSITION), "apply",
                        "--self-run-id", args.self_run_id,
                        "--window", _window], 1800)
            _results["apply"] = rc
            if rc != 0:
                return 1
            for name in wanted:
                kind, target, tmo = PHASES[name]
                log(f"== phase {name} ({kind}:{target}, tmo={tmo}s) ==")
                if kind == "transition":
                    argv = [sys.executable, str(TRANSITION), target,
                            "--window", _window]
                else:
                    interp = "node" if target.endswith(".mjs") else sys.executable
                    argv = [interp, str(ROOT / "scripts" / target)]
                rc = spawn(argv, tmo)
                _results[name] = rc
                log(f"phase {name}: {rc}")
                if rc != 0 and not args.keep_going:
                    break
        finally:
            restore_and_verify()
            _persist()
        bad = {k: v for k, v in _results.items() if v not in (0, "0")}
        return 1 if bad else 0
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """u7_off_smoke.py — OFF-phase proof on the transitioned isolated stack.
    
    Over real HTTP against the isolated state service (fixed 25900), after
    seeding ONLY its own fixture docs (fresh test state 404s otherwise):
    
      1. default-OFF gate: `start`, `continue` -> 501 gate=ACP_EXEC_START;
         `accept_result` -> 501 gate=ACP_EXEC_VALIDATION. Gate responses are
         only reachable PAST the CAS check, so every command carries the real
         expectedControlRevision read from GET /api/execution/cards/:id.
      2. non-launch-gated commands work while OFF: enable, attach_document
         (requirements + plan with {run,cwd,timeoutSec} checks),
         approve_requirements, approve_plan, save_preset.
      3. no launch while OFF: cardView.runs stays empty — approval alone
         never spawns; only the flag stands between approval and an agent.
      4. legacy surface: /api/state/{board,claims}.json shape,
         /api/porch/runs returns the REAL external registry through the new
         read-only steer mount (pre-transition deployment returned [] —
         recorded as a regression boundary, not silently claimed).
      5. marker nonce byte-identical disk<->HTTP.
    
    Never touches a live card or the production ops/registry dirs.
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import json
    import sys
    import time
    import urllib.error
    import urllib.request
    import uuid
    from pathlib import Path
    
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
    import _e2e_compose_harness as H  # noqa: E402
    
    CARD = "u7-card-off"
    PROJ_ID = "u7-proj-a"
    PROJ_LABEL = "u7-a"                     # resolves by name (real-card shape)
    SANDBOX = Path("/home/hermes/projects/acp-u7-sandbox")
    FAILED = []
    
    
    def check(name, cond, detail=""):
        tag = "PASS" if cond else "FAIL"
        print(f"{tag}  {name} {detail}", flush=True)
        if not cond:
            FAILED.append(f"{name}: {detail}")
    
    
    def get_card(card_id):
        """cardView from the real GET route — 404 -> None."""
        status, body = H.http_json(
            "GET", f"{H.STATE_URL}/api/execution/cards/{card_id}")
        return body if status == 200 else None
    
    
    def control_revision(card_id):
        view = get_card(card_id)
        if not isinstance(view, dict) or "controlRevision" not in view:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"card view for {card_id} missing controlRevision: {view}")
        return int(view["controlRevision"])
    
    
    def cmd(card_id, type_, payload=None, revision=None):
        """User-channel command with a fresh isolation proof and the REAL
        current controlRevision (enable is pre-aggregate -> sends 0)."""
        H.verify_isolation()
        if revision is None:
            revision = control_revision(card_id)
        body = {
            "commandId": f"u7off:{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            "type": type_,
            "payload": payload or {},
            "expectedControlRevision": revision,
        }
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{H.STATE_URL}/api/execution/cards/{card_id}/commands",
            data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
            headers={"content-type": "application/json"},
            method="POST")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
                return r.status, json.loads(r.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            return e.code, json.loads(e.read())
    
    
    def seed_fixture() -> None:
        """Isolated fixture docs only — never assumed to pre-exist."""
        H.verify_isolation()
        status, _ = H.seed_doc("claims.json",
                               {"claims": {}, "attempts": {}})
        check("seed claims.json (empty)", status == 200, f"{status}")
        status, _ = H.seed_doc("projects.json", {
            "version": 1,
            "projects": [{
                "id": PROJ_ID, "name": PROJ_LABEL,
                "path": str(SANDBOX / "proj-a"),
                "createdAt": int(time.time() * 1000),
            }],
            "activeProjectId": PROJ_ID,
        })
        check("seed projects.json", status == 200, f"{status}")
        now = int(time.time() * 1000)
        status, _ = H.seed_doc("board.json", {
            "version": 2,
            "cards": [{
                "id": CARD, "title": "U7 OFF gate card",
                "description": "off-phase fixture", "project": PROJ_LABEL,
                "agent": "", "priority": "normal", "acceptance": "",
                "verification": "", "links": [], "session": None,
                "blocked": False, "blockedReason": "", "cancelled": False,
                "touches": [], "dependsOn": [], "blocks": [],
                "conflictsWith": [], "stage": "backlog", "status": "todo",
                "order": 0, "createdAt": now, "updatedAt": now,
            }],
        })
        check("seed board.json", status == 200, f"{status}")
    
    
    def main() -> int:
        print("== u7_off_smoke: isolation ==")
        try:
            H.verify_isolation()
            check("isolation marker+dir", True)
        except H.HarnessError as e:
            check("isolation marker+dir", False, str(e))
            print("\nFAILURES:", "; ".join(FAILED))
            return 1
        disk_nonce = H.expected_marker()
        status, marker = H.http_json(
            "GET", f"{H.STATE_URL}/api/state/{H.MARKER_DOC}")
        check("marker nonce disk==HTTP",
              status == 200
              and (marker.get("data") or {}).get("nonce") == disk_nonce,
              f"status={status}")
    
        print("== legacy surface ==")
        h_status, h = H.http_json("GET", f"{H.STATE_URL}/health")
        check("health dir is isolated",
              h_status == 200 and h.get("dir") == str(H.TEST_STATE_DIR),
              h.get("dir"))
    
        seed_fixture()
    
        status, board = H.http_json("GET", f"{H.STATE_URL}/api/state/board.json")
        check("board.json legacy shape",
              status == 200 and board.get("name") == "board.json"
              and isinstance(board.get("data"), dict)
              and any(c.get("id") == CARD
                      for c in board["data"].get("cards", [])))
        status, claims = H.http_json("GET", f"{H.STATE_URL}/api/state/claims.json")
        check("claims.json legacy shape",
              status == 200 and isinstance(claims.get("data"), dict))
        status, runs = H.http_json("GET", f"{H.STATE_URL}/api/porch/runs")
        n = len((runs or {}).get("runs") or [])
        check("external porch runs visible via ro steer mount",
              status == 200 and n >= 1,
              f"runs={n} (pre-transition deployment returned 0)")
        check("external runs carry no managed fields",
              all("managed" not in (r or {}) and "porchRunId" not in (r or {})
                  for r in (runs.get("runs") or [])[:50]))
    
        print("== OFF gate ==")
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "enable", revision=0)
        check("enable ok (not launch-gated)",
              st == 200 and body.get("ok") is True,
              f"status={st} {body.get('error', '')}")
        check("cardView now managed with controlRevision 1",
              (get_card(CARD) or {}).get("controlRevision") == 1)
    
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "start")
        check("start gated 501/ACP_EXEC_START",
              st == 501 and body.get("gate") == "ACP_EXEC_START",
              f"{st} {body.get('code')} gate={body.get('gate')}")
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "continue")
        check("continue gated 501/ACP_EXEC_START",
              st == 501 and body.get("gate") == "ACP_EXEC_START",
              f"{st} {body.get('code')}")
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "accept_result",
                       {"runId": "run_none", "resultSha256": "0" * 64})
        check("accept_result gated 501/ACP_EXEC_VALIDATION",
              st == 501 and body.get("gate") == "ACP_EXEC_VALIDATION",
              f"{st} {body.get('code')}")
        # CAS actually enforced: a stale revision must 409, not slip through.
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "start", revision=0)
        check("stale expectedControlRevision -> 409 revision_conflict",
              st == 409 and body.get("code") == "revision_conflict",
              f"{st} {body.get('code')}")
    
        print("== setup commands work while OFF ==")
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "attach_document", {
            "kind": "requirements",
            "source": {"type": "text",
                       "text": "# requirements\nset VALUE = 42 in main.py\n"}})
        check("attach requirements", st == 200, f"{st} {body.get('error','')}")
        req_v = (body.get("result") or {})
        check("attach returns versionId+sha256",
              isinstance(req_v.get("versionId"), str)
              and isinstance(req_v.get("sha256"), str)
              and len(req_v.get("sha256", "")) == 64)
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "approve_requirements", {
            "versionId": req_v.get("versionId"),
            "sha256": req_v.get("sha256"), "by": "u7-off-smoke"})
        check("approve requirements", st == 200,
              f"{st} {body.get('error','')}")
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "attach_document", {
            "kind": "plan",
            "source": {"type": "text", "text": "# plan\n- edit main.py\n"},
            "checks": [{"run": "python3 -c 'import main; assert main.VALUE == 42'",
                        "timeoutSec": 30}]})
        check("attach plan w/ real checks shape", st == 200,
              f"{st} {body.get('error','')}")
        plan_v = (body.get("result") or {})
        check("plan bound to requirements version",
              (plan_v.get("requirementsBound") or {}).get("versionId")
              == req_v.get("versionId"))
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "approve_plan", {
            "versionId": plan_v.get("versionId"),
            "sha256": plan_v.get("sha256"), "by": "u7-off-smoke"})
        check("approve plan", st == 200, f"{st} {body.get('error','')}")
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "save_preset", {"preset": {
            "name": "u7-off-pi", "id": "u7-preset-off",
            "members": {
                "implementer": {"cli": "pi",
                                "model": "zen-relay/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free"},
                "reviewer": {"cli": "pi",
                             "model": "zen-relay/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free"},
                "checker": {"cli": "pi",
                            "model": "zen-relay/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free"}},
            "limits": {"maxAttemptsPerRole": 1, "timeoutMin": 10,
                       "maxReviewRounds": 1}}})
        check("save_preset accepted", st == 200,
              f"{st} {body.get('error','')}")
        check("composition snapshot bound to card",
              (get_card(CARD) or {}).get("composition", {})
              .get("presetId") == "u7-preset-off")
    
        print("== no launch while OFF ==")
        st, body = cmd(CARD, "start")
        check("start still 501 after full approval+preset",
              st == 501 and body.get("gate") == "ACP_EXEC_START", f"{st}")
        view = get_card(CARD)
        check("cardView shape has runs array",
              isinstance(view, dict) and isinstance(view.get("runs"), list))
        check("zero runs exist (approval never launches)",
              view["runs"] == [], f"runs={view['runs']}")
        check("runner has no live children",
              H.proc_rows_idle("runner"), "docker top shows acp-runner only")
    
        print(f"\n{'ALL PASS' if not FAILED else 'FAILURES: ' + '; '.join(FAILED)}")
        return 0 if not FAILED else 1
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())

    $ cat scripts/u7_orphan_probe.py
    #!/usr/bin/env python3
    """u7_orphan_probe.py — listener-free proof of u7_run's group drain.
    
    Cases (no services touched):
      A) leader exits nonzero while a `sleep` grandchild keeps the PGID —
         spawn() returns the leader's code AND the whole group is dead after.
      B) timeout — leader+grandchild in the group are drained via killpg.
      C) clean exit — drain is a harmless no-op (group already gone).
    
    Prints PASS/FAIL lines; exit 0 only when all three hold.
    """
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import subprocess
    import sys
    import time
    from pathlib import Path
    
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
    import u7_run  # noqa: E402
    
    FAILED = []
    
    
    def check(name, cond, detail=""):
        print(f"{'PASS' if cond else 'FAIL'}  {name} {detail}", flush=True)
        if not cond:
            FAILED.append(name)
    
    
    def spawn_capture(argv, timeout):
        """Like u7_run.spawn but captures stdout and returns (rc, pgid)."""
        p = subprocess.Popen(argv, start_new_session=True,
                             stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        u7_run._pgid = p.pid
        pgid = p.pid
        try:
            rc = p.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            rc = "timeout"
        finally:
            try:
                p.wait(timeout=2)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                pass
            u7_run.drain_group()
        out = (p.stdout.read() or "").strip()
        return rc, pgid, out
    
    
    def main() -> int:
        # A) leader exits 7, grandchild `sleep 300` outlives it in the group
        rc, pgid, out = spawn_capture(
            ["bash", "-c", "echo pgid=$$; sleep 300 & exit 7"], 30)
        check("A leader exit code preserved", rc == 7, f"rc={rc}")
        check("A orphan grandchild group drained", not u7_run.group_alive(pgid),
              f"pgid={pgid}")
    
        # B) timeout — leader sleeps forever with a grandchild too
        t0 = time.time()
        rc, pgid, out = spawn_capture(
            ["bash", "-c", "echo pgid=$$; sleep 300 & sleep 300"], 2)
        check("B timeout bounded", rc == "timeout" and time.time() - t0 < 30,
              f"rc={rc} dt={time.time() - t0:.1f}")
        check("B whole group drained after timeout",
              not u7_run.group_alive(pgid), f"pgid={pgid}")
    
        # C) clean exit — drain no-op
        rc, pgid, out = spawn_capture(["bash", "-c", "echo pgid=$$; exit 0"], 30)
        check("C clean exit rc=0", rc == 0, f"rc={rc}")
        check("C group already gone (drain no-op)",
              not u7_run.group_alive(pgid), f"pgid={pgid}")
    
        print("ALL PASS" if not FAILED else f"FAILURES: {FAILED}")
        return 0 if not FAILED else 1
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        sys.exit(main())
